mechanism: Ciprofloxacin may chelate divalent cations and potentially reduce zoledronic acid absorption/efficacy; additive risk of renal impairment with both agents; fluoroquinolone-associated risk of tendon rupture may be elevated with bisphosphonate-related musculoskeletal effects.
action: Separate administration by 2+ hours if oral formulation used; monitor renal function closely; assess for musculoskeletal symptoms; ensure adequate hydration with both agents.
